title: SDC Data Collection Project
description: SDC platform — SDC Data Collection Project. Auto-generated from Workato data-table exports. One $def per table. Cross-project refs resolve via $id.

error_code.description: Application-defined error code. Must match sql_error_code values used in the validation SQL.

human_readable_message.description: Supplier-facing error text. May include placeholders defined in required_placeholders.

required_placeholders.description: Placeholder tokens used in human_readable_message (e.g., 'field_name,expected_value'). Empty string if none.

field_name.description: Column name in the upload template. Immutable within a version.

data_type.description: Expected type: string | integer | date | decimal | boolean.

required.description: Whether the field must have a value.

must_be_empty.description: If true, this field must be blank in submissions. Used for system-managed or read-only columns.

column_unique.description: Whether values must be unique across all rows.

lookup_name.description: Soft join → CFG_Lookup.lookup_name (scoped by shared template_version_id). Name-based by convention.

x-fk.rationale: Name-based join, not UUID-based. Resolved at runtime by shared value.

depends_on.description: FK → CFG_Field.field_id of the parent field in a cascading dropdown.

field_length_validation.description: Character count limits for text fields (e.g., 'min:1,max:50').

field_input_validation.description: Input validation as a regular expression.

strict.description: Does a single-field validation failure reject the entire row? Defaults to false if null.

visible.description: Whether this field appears on the WFA intake form. Used by CFG_FormSlot generation.

control_type.description: WFA widget type (e.g., text, dropdown, date). Derived from data_type and lookup_name during form slot generation.

field_name.description: Display label shown to the supplier. Copied from CFG_Field.field_name.

slot_name.description: Maps to the corresponding slot field on WFA_SupplierRequest (e.g., 'slot_text_01'). Used as the lookup key when saving manual entries.

x-fk.rationale: Name-based join, not UUID-based. Resolved at runtime by shared value.
x-fk.note: Maps logical slot_name to a fixed slot column on WFA_SupplierRequest (e.g. slot_text_01).

control_type.description: WFA widget type (e.g., text | number | dropdown | date | checkbox).

required.description: Whether the WFA form enforces this field as required. Independent of CFG_Field.required (validation level).

lookup_name.description: Soft join → CFG_lookup.lookup_name. Populates dropdown options when the widget type (control_type) is dropdown.

x-fk.rationale: Name-based join, not UUID-based. Resolved at runtime by shared value.

lookup_name.description: Logical group name. Joined from CFG_Field.lookup_name. Immutable within a version.

valid_value.description: Acceptable value for this lookup option.

parent_value.description: When the parent field (identified by CFG_Field.depends_on) has this value, this option is available in the dependent dropdown.

project_specific.description: If true, this value is client-specific and excluded from the reusable template snapshot.

field_id.description: FK → CFG_Field.field_id. The primary field this rule validates. Immutable.

target_field.description: Denormalized display name of the field referenced by field_id. Not a join key.

rule.description: Verb or phrase defining the cross-field relationship (e.g., 'must_equal', 'required_when').

condition_field.description: Denormalized display name of the field referenced by condition_field_id. Not a join key.

condition_field_id.description: FK → CFG_Field.field_id. The secondary field that triggers the rule or acts as a baseline for comparison.

conditional_value.description: Specific input value on the condition field that triggers the rule.

error_message.description: Default actionable error instruction for the output report.

error_message_custom.description: Custom actionable error instruction for the output report. Overrides error_message when present.

strict_enforcement.description: If false, violation is a warning, not a rejection.

template_version_id.description: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.template_version_id. Required. Every rule must be version-scoped.

field_name_display.description: Relation → CFG_Field. Displays field_name for UI readability.

variant_name.description: Human-readable label (e.g., 'UK Resources', 'US Resources'). Immutable within a version.

description.description: Explanation of when/why this variant is assigned.

template_file_id.description: Workato FileStorage ID of this variant's XLSX.

field_id.description: FK → CFG_Field.field_id. Anchors error to a version via CFG_Field.template_version_id.

row_number.description: Source row index in the submitted file.

submitted_value.description: The value that failed. May be null for required-field violations.

error_message.description: Human-readable error. Source: CFG_Rule.error_message, CFG_Field validation, or CFG_ErrorTranslation.

field_name_display.description: Relation → CFG_Field. Displays field_name for UI readability.

supplier_request_id.description: Relation → WFA_Supplier_request. Scopes rows to a single request. Used by WFA table widget as relatedColumnId.

row_number.description: Worker number. Incremented for each saved worker.

field_name.description: Denormalized from CFG_Field.field_name. Displayed as a column header in WFA table widget. Read-only for suppliers.

submitted_value.description: Value entered by the supplier via the WFA form. Editable until submission.

x-fk.rationale: Cross-project reference. Resolved in two-pass provisioning.

author_email.description: Email address of the note's author.

note_text.description: Free-text note. May be empty for approvals with no comment.

review_action.description: 'approved' or 'rework'. Records what the analyst decided.

upload_id.description: Business PK (UUID). Generated at submission time.

template_version_id.description: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.template_version_id. Frozen at creation. Copied from WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_version_id.

submitted_file_id.description: FileStorage ID of the raw uploaded file. Immutable.

extracted_file_version_id.description: FileStorage ID after extraction/normalization. Written during validation pipeline.

status.description: Values: received | extracting | validating | validated | failed.

valid_payload.description: Validated row data as JSON. Large payloads may require monitoring for field truncation.

validation_result_id.description: Business PK (UUID). Generated by the validation recipe.

template_version_id.description: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.template_version_id. Copied from RUN_Upload.template_version_id. Direct traceability.

valid_rows.description: Count of passing rows. Write-once after validation completes.

invalid_rows.description: Count of failing rows. Write-once after validation completes.

x-fk.rationale: Cross-project reference. Resolved in two-pass provisioning.
x-fk.note: Cross-project audit reference. SYS_EventLogs is in 'Data collection' but written by Base recipes (B-01, B-05) as well as Data collection recipes.

source_recipe.description: The recipe writing to this data table.

phase.description: Represent business-meaningful states.  Intake phases {webhook_received, webhook_validated, webhook_rejected, request_routed};   Project setup phases {workspace_provisioned, request_marked_active};   Provisioning phases {provisioning_started, config_validated, config_invalid, config_failed_to_parse, schema_persisted, templates_generated, suppliers_bootstrapped, suppliers_migrated, incumbent_data_seeded, version_published};   Cross-cutting phases {error, recipe_completed, recipe_failed};

template_version_id.description: Business PK (UUID). Generated by at provision time.

status.description: Values: draft | published | deprecated. Forward transitions only.

master_template_file_id.description: Workato FileStorage ID for the master template file. Set at publish.

manifest_id.description: FK → home base Manifests.id. Ties version to its build artifact. Immutable.

x-fk.rationale: Cross-project reference. Resolved in two-pass provisioning.

published_at.description: Write-once. Set when status transitions to 'published'.

validation_summary.description: Version-level validation summary. May contain structured JSON.

x-fk.note: FK inferred from field name; not explicitly hinted in source schema.

assigned_variant_id.description: FK → CFG_Variant.variant_id. Null means use base field definitions with no visibility overrides. Immutable once set.

x-fk.rationale: Cross-project reference. Resolved in two-pass provisioning.

supplier_name.description: Display name of the supplier. Set at provision time. Immutable.

primary_user_email.description: Supplier contact. May be updated if contact changes.

assignee_email.description: Analyst who owns this request. Immutable.

template_file_id.description: Shareable link to the supplier's XLSX template. Set at supplier onboarding, then regenerated on reminder.

has_seeded_data.description: Whether seed data was provided at request creation.

seeded_data_file_id.description: FileStorage ID for pre-populated data file.

seeded_template_file_id.description: FileStorage ID for the seeded template sent to supplier.

latest_upload_file_id.description: FileStorage ID of the most recent supplier upload. Overwritten on each submission.

status.description: Indicates lifecycle stage. Values: pending | sent | in_progress | submitted | validated | accepted | rejected.

last_updated_at.description: Timestamp of last status or field change.
